_comment: STEP 3+4 at full DEM resolution. Same area as 02 but on a 30 m grid, where the 30 m DEM is actually resolved rather than downsampled. Flow routing is not tiled, so this holds about 6 million cells in memory and takes a while; specific catchment area is resolution-sensitive, so the parameters must be refitted at this grid rather than carried over from 02.
